limitations: Shares are the publications' own over MOTORISED main-mode trips; the active (walk/cycle) share is a separate statement over all trips and is approximate as printed.
A multimodal trip is classified by its main mode (train or metro when one is boarded), as the CTS states; access and egress legs are not trips here.
The MMR 2017 and Greater Mumbai 2014 surveys are different areas and years; neither is the base year, and no projection is applied here.
No target is derived here: the mapping of Rickshaw/Taxi, Metro & Mono and the active share onto the simulated modes is the target builder's, with the record.
